image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a handmade patchwork baby bib lying flat on a neutral beige fabric surface. The bib features a quilted design with squares of various floral and patterned fabrics in shades of mint green, yellow, and pink. It has a central vertical strip of solid mint green fabric with an embroidered pocket or decorative element featuring two blue eyes. The neck area has white fabric ties that are knotted or looped.
